rows.reply_en:
Dear,

To swap a shift, open the shift in the app and tap "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap). Colleagues with the same role can then accept the swap. If manager approval is enabled, the manager approves it under Rooster → Verzoeken (Rota → Requests).

Best regards,
Team Roosterly
rows.verified_en: Dear, To swap a shift, open the shift in the app and tap "Ruil aanbieden". Colleagues with the same role can then accept the swap. If manager approval is on, the manager approves the request under Rooster → Verzoeken. With kind regards, Team Roosterly

rows.reply_en:
Dear,

The Plus plan costs €6 per active employee per month (excluding VAT). For 25 active employees, this amounts to €150 per month, excluding VAT.

You can upgrade at any time under Instellingen → Abonnement (Settings → Subscription). The new price applies from the next invoice.

Kind regards,
Team Roosterly
